description: Editing a segment and assigning speakers.

preconditions: Voice SPEAKER_00 exists on the recording; actor is the current secretary.
A member of the meeting matches the user id.
cases.inputs: recordingId: a transcribed recording; label: "SPEAKER_00"; userId: a meeting member; guestId: null; actorId: the current secretary.
cases.return: Success with the voice and the assigned name (MSG316 "Đã gán người nói.").
cases.log: Saved: assigned user, assigner and time; audit row records the naming and whether it accepts the machine suggestion.

preconditions: No voice with the label exists on the recording; actor is the current secretary.
cases.inputs: recordingId: a transcribed recording; label: "SPEAKER_09"; userId: a meeting member; guestId: null; actorId: the current secretary.
cases.return: Failure NotFound; answered as if the voice does not exist.

preconditions: Voice SPEAKER_00 exists; actor is the current secretary.
The user id belongs to nobody on the meeting roster.
cases.inputs: recordingId: a transcribed recording; label: "SPEAKER_00"; userId: an outsider; guestId: null; actorId: the current secretary.

preconditions: Voice SPEAKER_00 exists; actor takes part in the meeting but is not the secretary.
cases.inputs: recordingId: a transcribed recording; label: "SPEAKER_00"; userId: a meeting member; guestId: null; actorId: a member who is not the secretary.
